ETH-base provides no independent signal for INJ. VERDICT: KEEP K500 INJ-BTC. K662 rejected — no diversification benefit. Contrast: WLD-ETH K629 works because WLD vol is more moderate and BTC-G5 blockage was structural (0.46) not a vol-dominance artifact.
